notes.title: dsync now with Steam VR! Add -vrmode openvr to the launch arguments!
notes.content: The latest release of dsync supports Steam VR!  Just add -vrmode openvr to the launch arguments :-)

notes.title: dsync out now!
notes.content: dsync is now available to purchase in the steam store!

notes.title: dsync launching today!
notes.content: dsync will be available today from 12.00pm PDT (8.00pm GMT)

notes.title: Release date imminent!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The developers are hard at work getting everything ready for dsync's imminent release - 15th June 2018.

Grab the game on Steam then and enjoy some retro shoot-em-up action!

notes.title: The Leaderboard Challenge...
notes.content: All the developers are busy trying to set some challenging Leaderboard targets ready for the game's release date. Go on, let's see what you're made of!

notes.title: dsync approved for release!
notes.content: dsync approved for release! Coming to a PC near you on June 15th 2018.
